issues.issue: Is the claimant a genuine underground Christian who faces serious persecution in Fujian?
issues.applicant_position: Claimant was raided by PSB after joining an underground church and fears arrest if returned.
issues.result_text: No serious persecution risk for Christians in Fujian; claimant not credible about the PSB raid.

issues.issue: Does the claimant face forced IUD or other family planning persecution as a mother of two children?
issues.applicant_position: Fears forced IUD under family planning rules as a mother of two children.
issues.result_text: Canadian-born child does not count; claimant could choose her own contraception under Fujian rules.
